subject: Urgent password reset notice
body: You requested a password reset at 09:15. If this was not you, call the IT service desk using the number in the staff directory. This message has no sign-in link.

subject: Invoice 4821 needs review
body: The finance team marked invoice 4821 for review. Please open the copy already stored in the shared project drive. Do not send payment details by email.

subject: Security alert from university IT
body: A sign-in from a new campus computer was recorded. Check your recent activity through the university portal you normally use, or contact the service desk.

subject: Confirm seminar attendance
body: Please confirm whether you will attend Friday's research seminar by replying to this message. No account information is required.

subject: Payroll details reminder
body: HR is checking that staff records are current. If your address has changed, update it through the normal employee portal before the end of the month.

subject: Mailbox migration next week
body: The planned mailbox migration begins on Monday. You may be asked to sign in again when Outlook restarts. The IT team will not ask for your password.

subject: Refund processed
body: Your travel refund has been approved and will reach the bank account already held by finance. You do not need to provide any details.

subject: Document shared after supervision
body: I added the revised chapter to our usual shared folder after today's meeting. The filename is chapter-three-comments.docx.

subject: Survey thank-you voucher
body: Thank you for completing the student survey. The library desk will email collection details for the small voucher next week.

subject: Action required for module choice
body: Module selection closes on Friday. Review your choices in the student system and speak to your programme administrator if anything is missing.

subject: Updated meeting notes
body: I could not open the shared folder, so I placed the notes on a new document site. Use the access page below and sign in to read my comments.

subject: Missed parcel at reception
body: Reception could not accept your parcel. Use the delivery page today to choose another time and confirm your address.

subject: Research participant payment
body: Your participation payment is ready. Complete the short account form linked below so the transfer can be released.

subject: Library account message
body: A problem was found with your library record. Follow the attached instructions before tomorrow to prevent borrowing restrictions.

subject: Conference registration update
body: The registration system lost your booking information. Re-enter the details through the replacement form to keep your place.

subject: Application document returned
body: The recruitment team could not read your application. Open the attached file, enable editing and follow the document prompt.

subject: New voicemail transcription
body: A caller left a private message about your course. The transcription is available through the audio viewer linked in this email.

subject: Calendar invitation failed
body: The seminar invitation could not be added automatically. Open the calendar page and authorise the new connection.

subject: Cloud storage renewal
body: Your stored files have been moved to read-only mode. Restore normal access by completing the renewal check today.

subject: Supervisor file request
body: Please upload the draft to this temporary review page rather than the department drive. The page will ask you to confirm your university login.
